ud2.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikass' ārāme.
ud2.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā kumārakā antarā ca Sāvatthiṃ antarā ca Jetavanaṃ ahiṃ daṇḍena hananti.
ud2.3:1.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
ud2.3:1.5: addasā kho bhagavā sambahule kumārake antarā ca Savatthiṃ antarā ca Jetavanaṃ ahiṃ daṇḍena hanante.
ud2.3:2.1: atha kho bhagavā etaṃ atthaṃ viditvā tayaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
